description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the AdjustVideoColor operation in the video production (videoenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍视频生产（videoenhan）类目下的视频校色AdjustVideoColor的语法及示例
name: AdjustVideoColor

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The bitrate of the output video. Unit: M. Default value: 20. Valid values: 8 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频码率，单位为M，默认20M，取值范围`[8,200]`
parameters.name: video_bitrate

parameters.help_en: The encoding format of the output video. Valid values: h264, hevc, and prores. Default value: h264
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频编码格式，可选h264、hevc、prores三种。默认值为h264
parameters.name: video_codec

parameters.help_en: The format of the output video. Valid values: mp4 and mov. Default value: mp4
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频格式，可选mp4、mov两种。默认值为mp4
parameters.name: video_format

parameters.help_en: The color grading mode. Default value: LogC. For more information, see Color grading modes
parameters.help_zh: 指定调色模式，默认值为LogC。具体请参见调色模式说明
parameters.name: mode

Data.description_en: The returned result data. This data is obtained after the asynchronous task is executed successfully by invoking the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and performing JSON deserialization on the Result field
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the color-graded video.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
VideoUrl.description_zh:
调色后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The prompt message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
